citations.claim: At step 2 body 0 centre at (14.68, 9.87) overlaps wall 0 by 0.228 beyond 0.15 limit
y at violating step shows centre only 0.27 above wall top, well within radius so deep overlap
Step 1 shows body just 0.023 above wall surface before impact, confirming high-speed grazing impact into thin wall

counterfactual.change: Reduced tangential speed vx from -49.99 to -10.0 only; body then contacts wall top slowly and no penetration occurs.

explanation: High-speed (~53 m/s) diagonal graze into thin (0.2 thick) wall: step 1 body is 0.023 above surface, step 2 it has translated ~0.63 in one dt and embeds 0.228 into wall. Impulse plus positional correction fails to de-penetrate within the step despite 22 substeps, leaving overlap above 0.15 limit. Slowing tangential velocity removes the failure.
vision_note: The red circle moves down-left toward the right tip of the thin horizontal wall. By step 2 it ends up sitting embedded in the end of the wall rather than resting on top of it.
